text.p: A rally in high technologies and growing confidence that Republicans will keep control of Congress propelled the Nasdaq Composite Index to a strong close on Tuesday.
Over-the-counter trading was dominated by a powerhouse performance by high technology issues, in particular networking stocks which rallied on a strong earnings report from U.S. Robotics Corp.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 8.58 points, or 0.70 percent, at 1229.06 at its unofficial close, while declines led advancing issues by 2137 to 2010 on volume of about 574 million shares.
Despite the rally, the Composite was still shy of its October 15 close at 1258.10.

U.S. Robotics, which was up 1-1/2 at 61 and topped the Nasdaq most active list, reported fiscal fourth quarter earnings after the close of trading on Monday and was considered a possible harbinger of Cisco Systems Inc's fiscal first quarter earnings report, due after the close of trading today. Cisco shares were up 1-1/8 at 61-3/4 in anticipation of the report.
Shares of Intel Corp rallied 3-5/8 to 114.
